newsitem.title: UK: LME copper holds afternoon gains in late London.
newsitem.headline: LME copper holds afternoon gains in late London.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) three months copper held the firmer level reached by the kerb close in uneventful late inter-office activity on Wednesday. Copper had leapt higher during the Wednesday afternoon ring and kerb trading, with the market doing a 180-degree turn and finishing close to the peaks of the day's range.
Traders said an impressive recovery from a midday nadir of $1,900 was mostly due to shortcovering after earlier speculative selling failed to hit the sub-$1,900 stops.
Final kerb trade was at $1,950, up $25 a tonne from Tuesday, and copper was bid at $1,955 by 1900GMT when Comex closed.
Aluminium was bid at $1,429 after a kerb close at $1,428, up $21 from Tuesday.
